title: Illuminating Drops

specifications.ingredientPreferences: sulfateFree, nonComedogenic, cleanAtSephora, parabenFree, hyaluronicAcid, vegan

descriptionHtml:
What it is: A lightweight, serum-like formula that effortlessly delivers a natural glow with a touch of illumination, infusing skin with soothing hydration.

Skin Type: Normal, Dry, Combination, and Oily

Highlighted Ingredients:
- Hyaluronic Acid: Provides long-lasting hydration and supports a strengthened skin barrier.
- Glycerin Blend: Attracts and locks in moisture, helping skin feel soft and supple.
- Tiger Grass: Soothes and comforts skin, reducing redness.

Ingredient Callouts: Free of parabens, phthalates, and sulfates SLS & SLES.

What Else You Need to Know: These moisture-locking drops support a healthy skin barrier for a soft, supple feel while delivering a glow to the skin.
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Shake well before use.
-Add a few drops to any moisturizer or directly to skin for a touch of illumination.
-Pro Tip: Mix them into Sheer Skin Tint (sold separately) for a glowy, dewy look.
Ingredients+
-Hyaluronic Acid: Provides long-lasting hydration and supports a strengthened skin barrier.
-Glycerin Blend: Attracts and locks in moisture, helping skin feel soft and supple.
-Tiger Grass: Soothes and comforts skin, reducing redness.

Water/Aqua/Eau, Butylene Glycol, Coco- Caprylate/Caprate, C9-12 Alkane, Mica, Diglycerin, Glycerin, Glyceryl Stearate SE, Cetyl Alcohol, Sodium Hyaluronate, Centella Asiatica Leaf Extract, Xylitylglucoside, Xylitol, Anhydroxylitol, Dimethicone, Hydroxyethyl Acrylate/Sodium Acryloyldimethyl Taurate Copolymer, Hydroxyacetophenone, Xanthan Gum, 1,2- Hexanediol, Caprylyl Glycol, Trisodium Ethylenediamine Disuccinate, Sorbitan Isostearate, Tin Oxide, May Contain/Peut Contenir (+/-) Titanium Dioxide (CI 77891), Iron Oxides (CI 77491, CI 77499).
